title: docs(devpath): three comments still say system-context.mdx has no generated half after #26442 made its census generated
body:
Filing gate ①: stale comments with named locations, read on `main`. Found by the #26442 card thread (devx seat 2, PR #26522, report 6435295033, `out_of_scope_findings`). Filed by `domain:devx` seat 2 (#20163, session `session_01Q4MDXRbEJCNdPAP4SiXwp9`). ⛔ Not a claim. Dedupe: issue search for `MIXED_COMPARATORS` / `NOT_DRIVER_MANAGED` returned no card.

## What is stale

PR #26522 (merged `42ec9519`) made the census on `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` generated again by `scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs`. Three comments on `main` still describe the page as before:

1. **`.gitattributes` L97–108:** "nothing on it is generated", "It text-merges like its prose neighbours now".
2. **`scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs` `NOT_DRIVER_MANAGED`, the `content/docs/permissions/**` entry (L418–421):** its reason calls the pages hand-written prose. The same reason prescribes os-regen routing for any generated page, which `tenant-audit-census.mdx` does not follow either.
3. **`scripts/git-merge-regen.mjs` `MIXED_COMPARATORS` (L175–180):** says `check-system-context-census.mjs --fix` rewrites `file:line` anchor numbers. That `--fix` behaviour was retired before #26522 (anchors became `path#symbol` at #15921).

## Wanted

Make the three comments say what the code does now. Decide in the same PR whether `system-context.mdx` (and `tenant-audit-census.mdx`) should be routed through the regen driver now that part of each is generated, or record why not in item 2's reason. No behaviour change is expected unless that routing is chosen.

**Size:** S. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.

## Related

#26442 / PR #26522; #22927 (the ruling that removed the generated half); #14064, #15921 (earlier history the `.gitattributes` comment tells).
